findings.mechanism: Section tree has parent<->child links, which would be an Rc cycle, but the parent link is a Weak and only children hold strong Rc.
findings.cause: parent back-link is Weak<Section> (section.rs:10, set via Rc::downgrade at :31), so dropping Parsed.root frees the whole tree
findings.evidence: Built release and ran --iterations 1000, 20000, 200000, 1000000; peak RSS (ru_maxrss) was flat at ~12.9 MB in every run. Service holds only two u64 counters; no statics, caches, thread-locals or registrations exist in the code (380 lines read in full).
findings.discriminator: Peak RSS does not grow with document count (12.9 MB at 1k and at 1M documents); parent is Weak so no strong cycle exists.
